performance_intent: Commit title explicitly fixes a performance decrease for UC=char by splitting the eight-digit scan paths
checked_scope: Eight-char16 SIMD scan with arbitrary code units and accumulator; fixed ten-code-unit parse_number_string and public from_chars<double,char16_t> witness
checker: Alive2 for changed scan and parser; historical GCC 11 native binaries for public API
compiler: Clang 20.1.8 -std=c++20 -O2 -msse2 for Alive2 IR; GCC 11.4.0 -std=c++20 -O2 -msse2 for public runtime witness
clang_intrinsic_alias: Clang 20 lacks GCC's _mm_cvtsi128_si64x spelling; both IR revisions map it to _mm_cvtsi128_si64, whose local compiler headers implement the same low-64-bit extraction

result.public_native: Both accept and consume 10 char16_t units; old output bits 3ff45cb8cdbc60ef, new 40034fbf71c56a2d
result.public_alive2: unsupported: rounds_to_nearest emits a volatile floating-point load that installed Alive2 cannot translate

limitations: Counterexample has non-ASCII char16_t units. It establishes unrestricted API difference, not a difference for valid decimal-digit strings. No official before/after benchmark score was measured.
